summary: Iteration 56 testing — DFR Home address, geocode, GPS track persistence, Travel Map route planner (Home→Job1), lazy-create JobTravelTracker on Job Detail, and Export dropdown DFR entry. 15/15 backend pytest tests PASS (home GET/PUT auth-gated and per-user, geocode valid US address returns Tomball ~30.097/-95.616, geocode 400 for q<4 chars, 404 for gibberish, track persists on POST + PUT and is omitted from list projection). Frontend Playwright 10/10 critical flows PASS: Job Detail renders job-travel-tracker ABOVE the Job Files + Job Photo Gallery grid (tracker top=121 vs files/gallery top=288.5); Export dropdown still contains daily-field-report-btn → navigates to DFR page; after deleting today's DFR, merely VIEWING Job Detail does NOT auto-create a report (reports count=0, no row for job) proving lazy behavior; GPS Start Travel then creates the row with gps.travel_start and 4-phase progression (Start → Arrived → Leaving → Stop) works end-to-end; HomeAddress bar shows above the GPS tracker on the DFR page, clear → input returns, set with '100 Main St, Tomball, TX' geocodes and shows normalised address, persists through reload; Travel Map opens in Full Day mode by default, green Home pin label is rendered, Plan route produces leg 'Home → A050ABC 9.1 mi / 17 min / 0.25', Apply writes row 1 Travel to site hrs=0.25 + miles=9, and there is NO final leg back to Home (only 1 leg total for 1 job + home — matches 'NO final leg back home' spec).
critical_code_review_comments: field_reports.py:92-103 — home GET/PUT and :128-136 geocode are correctly declared BEFORE /field-reports/{report_id} so FastAPI won't shadow the literal paths with the UUID path param. Verified via tests (/home 200 before any {report_id} match attempt).

useDailyReport.js:34 — on load, after listing the user's reports for the date, the hook now re-fetches by id to retrieve the full doc (including `track`). This correctly fixes the earlier bug where GPS tracks were wiped on reload (list endpoint excludes `track`).

useDailyReport.js:35 — when autoRow=false (Job Detail tracker) and no server-side report exists for the date, the hook uses a local `blank(date)` object (id=null) so the UI renders without creating anything server-side. First `changeRow`/`onTrack` triggers `persist()` which POSTs lazily. Verified: visiting Job Detail with no DFR for today yields 0 reports via API.

JobTravelTracker.jsx:12 — `if (!job || !report) return null;` is only reached if the hook returned null (initial load state); once blank-report fallback resolves it renders. No regression observed in tests.

TestIDs confirmed working: dfr-home-address, dfr-home-address-text, dfr-home-input, dfr-home-set-btn, dfr-home-edit-btn, dfr-home-clear-btn, dfr-home-pin-label, dfr-plan-route-btn, dfr-apply-route-btn, dfr-route-legs, dfr-route-leg-N, dfr-travel-map-btn, dfr-travel-map-dialog, dfr-map-mode (shadcn Select — do NOT call Playwright .select_option with values not in {day, job}; default is 'day' = Full Day), job-travel-tracker, job-travel-tracker-status, job-open-dfr-link, daily-field-report-btn in export-dropdown-btn menu, dfr-travel-start-btn / dfr-arrived-btn / dfr-leaving-btn / dfr-stop-btn inside the job-travel-tracker scope. rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found; feature works end to end. Note: the earlier 'lazy_no_row_on_view: FAIL' observed in the first frontend run was a false positive caused by pre-existing seed data from the main agent's smoke test (today's DFR already contained an A050ABC row). After cleaning today's DFR and re-visiting Job Detail from a fresh state, the lazy behavior was correctly verified (no report created on view).
